notes: Generated by tools/gen-scv2-vectors.sh: real status-keycard applet 4.0.1 (37393a2) in jcardsim driven by the real host SDK status-keycard-java lib:4.0.0; randomness pinned, every value cross-checked with BouncyCastle lightweight primitives.
Regenerating changes only certificate.cert (r,s,v: the SDK's CA signature uses a random k) and handshake.card_signature_der (applet ECDSA uses a random k); all other values are fixed.
Keys are secp256k1; private key of a label = SHA256(UTF-8 label). Public keys: 33-byte compressed or 65-byte uncompressed (04||X||Y).

certificate.cert = identity_pub(33) || r(32) || s(32) || v(1) = 98 bytes, CA signature over SHA256(identity_pub). v is the RAW recovery id 0..3 (not +27): recovering with v yields the CA key; v+27 is invalid. The SDK left-strips zero bytes of r/s/priv without padding, so fields with a leading 0x00 would be short; the simulator redraws until full width.

Handshake: OPEN SECURE CHANNEL = 80 10 00 00 61 || salt(32) || host_eph_pub(65); response = card_eph_pub(65) || DER ECDSA signature || 9000. shared_x = X of ECDH (32 bytes); OKM = HKDF-SHA256(salt=salt, ikm=shared_x, info='sc_v2_ccm', L=32); key_h2c = OKM[0..16), key_c2h = OKM[16..32). transcript = 'sc_v2_ccm' || salt || host_eph_pub || card_eph_pub, signed (SHA256 prehash) with the card identity key from the cert.

CCM: AES-128-CCM, 8-byte tag, 13-byte nonce = big-endian message counter, no AAD (the outer header is not authenticated). Command: CT = CCM(key_h2c, nonce, CLA INS P1 P2 Lc data) (Lc always present), sent as 80 18 00 00 len(CT) CT. Response: CCM(key_c2h, same nonce, data || inner SW) || outer 9000. The counter starts at 0 after OPEN SECURE CHANNEL and increments once per command/response pair (the response reuses the command's nonce).
Card state for the CCM round trips: INIT with PIN 000000, PUK 123456789012, default retry counters, no key loaded; inner command is GET STATUS (application).
